assertions: One fixed Text Search (New) request uses only places.id, pageSize one and the declared language, region and location bias; it is followed serially by exactly one Place Details (New) request with a fixed field mask and no retry.
The result contains no more than five provider relevance-selected reviews and explicitly declares complete=false, first-result place resolution and unconfirmed caller place identity.
Every displayed review retains all available author attribution and a direct googleMapsUri; the UI also shows Google Maps attribution, relevance ordering and France visitDate when present.

Review text, author attribution, place name/address, review links, ratings, timestamps, place ID and the raw result digest exist only during the active attributed display and are absent from the Git verification candidate.

No Places content is cached or durably stored, no identity graph is constructed, and any later Research Dossier keeps only reviewed deidentified paraphrases and evidence references rather than provider content.
The ID-only Text Search request and single Place Details Enterprise + Atmosphere request are reconciled against the current Google Cloud billing surface with a hard maximum of USD 0.03.
Passing output remains candidate-only until the public Schema, terms/privacy/attribution surface, identity metadata and human knowledge admission are approved.
cleanup: Destroy any in-memory review and author content after the attributed probe display closes.
